SELECT a.*, u.user_name AS userName, u.id_card AS idCard FROM account a LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = a.user_id
AND a.user_id = #{userId}
AND a.account_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{accountNo}, '%')
AND u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%')
AND u.id_card LIKE CONCAT('%', #{idCard}, '%')
AND a.account_status = #{accountStatus}
ORDER BY a.account_id
